title: Verify Backup
description: Verify that a backup archive exists and is readable.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

BACKUP="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$BACKUP" || ! -f "$BACKUP" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 /path/to/backup.tar.gz" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -tzf "$BACKUP" >/dev/null

echo "Backup is readable and structurally valid: $BACKUP"
